SLE.note: Only an NCRA link to business registration is mentioned, not civil register to ID exchange.

facts.fact: President Bio launched the Online Business Registration System on 10 November 2026, operated by the National Investment Board, letting entrepreneurs apply, upload documents, track status and obtain registration certificates online.

SLE.note: Nothing on civil registration of births or deaths.
No rural connectivity programme or rural-urban internet use figures; only a rural access instruction for the registration platform.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates the ID system.
NIB worked with NCRA to integrate national identification information into registration, but the document does not say the register is keyed on the ID number.
Nothing on issuance, biometrics or audit of the ID system.
Nothing on local government office connection.
